name: Melbourne International Dumpling Festival
summary: A world of dumplings is returning to Melbourne. Join communities, cooks and food lovers at Queen Victoria Market for a public celebration of dumpling traditions from around the world.
attribution: Presented by Inhale Culture Celebrate Life Ltd.

name: MOMO Fest Melbourne 2026
summary: ICCL presented MOMO Fest Melbourne at Footscray Park on 11 and 12 April 2026, bringing together dumplings, multicultural food, music, performance and community activity across two public festival days.
attribution: Presented by Inhale Culture Celebrate Life Ltd.
